description: The rootfs images a player may hold, known by their digests (plan, stage 6: the user's installation without a history). The identity probe reads the rootfs's first blocks (first_blocks_bytes, the collectors profile's probe_blocks) and compares their SHA-256 with first_blocks_sha256. Stock is the official rootfs padded to the writer's size; every boot release from 2.57.5 records its own image (releases/<v>.json, image), built reproducibly from FiiO's update and the release; the images before it are listed here. The write's ABI a player has run (exercised) stands in for a staging capture of the user's own player. Digests only: no firmware is kept in this repository.

exercised.note: The write's ABI as the sixth write ran it on the owner's player (2026-10-08, boot release 2.57.4, session 83125c2d, in one USB Boot entry after the identity check): what an installation without a history uses unchanged, in place of a staging capture of its own player. Record it again after a developer's write has run a changed writer, SPL, payload, profile or RAM layout on a player.
